project_title: MCA Retro Arcade Portfolio - Haveloc / HCL GUVI Candidate

theme_strategy.aesthetic: Classic Arcade Dark (Neon Cyan, Electric Magenta, Pixel Gold on Obsidian Black with CRT Scanlines)
theme_strategy.context: High-impact memorable interactive portfolio for an MCA student applying to HCL GUVI via Haveloc. Styled as a playable 8-bit/16-bit arcade quest, combining nostalgic CRT retro visuals with ultra-slick modern web motion.

hierarchy_rules.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-arcade tracking-wider text-neon-cyan drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(6,182,212,0.8)]
hierarchy_rules.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-pixel uppercase tracking-widest text-neon-pink drop-shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(236,72,153,0.7)]

visual_enhancers.crt_scanline_overlay: Fixed non-blocking inset-0 background with repeating-linear-gradient and subtle CRT flicker effect (pointer-events-none, z-40)
visual_enhancers.retro_grid: Subtle 8-bit grid pattern in background using SVG radial dot matrix or grid line pattern
visual_enhancers.arcade_borders: Step/pixel corner illusion using Tailwind clip-path or nested sharp borders without smooth rounded radii for key components
visual_enhancers.sound_and_haptics: Optional Web Audio API synthesized 8-bit chiptune sound effects (beep, coin insert, level up) on click/hover with audio toggle button

key_features_and_sections.name: PRESS START Boot Screen & Kinetic Hero
features: Interactive Arcade Cabinet Boot Sequence: 'INSERT COIN / PRESS START' button to unlock full page sound and animations
Masked line-by-line title reveal: 'PLAYER 1: MCA CANDIDATE READY FOR HCL GUVI'
Live stats counter: HP 100%, LEVEL: MCA Final Year, GUVI STATUS: Qualified, HAVELOC ID: Active
Action buttons: 'START GAME / EXPLORE QUESTS' and 'DOWNLOAD RESUME (8-BIT PDF)'

key_features_and_sections.name: Chapter 01: Character Select & Origin Story
features: Character stats sheet: Academic specs, MCA Specialization, Haveloc application context, problem-solving mindset
Interactive bio chapters switchable like RPG character classes (Backend Wizard, Fullstack Knight, Algo Alchemist)
HCL GUVI alignment mission banner highlighting readiness for enterprise software challenges

key_features_and_sections.name: Chapter 02: Skill Trees & XP Stats Bar
features: Interactive XP progress bars with animated numbers and glowing pixel meters
Categorized Skill Inventory: Core CS (DS/Algo, DBMS, OS), Frontend (React, Tailwind), Backend (FastAPI, Python, Node, SQL), Cloud & Tools (Git, Docker, CI/CD)
Combos & Special Moves badges (e.g. 'Triple Stack Combo: React + FastAPI + Postgres')

key_features_and_sections.name: Chapter 03: Quest Logs (MCA Projects)
features: Quest Cards styled as classic game levels (LEVEL 1: Enterprise AI System, LEVEL 2: Fullstack E-Commerce, LEVEL 3: Realtime Analytics Engine)
Difficulty rating badges (BOSS LEVEL, HARD, INSANE)
Interactive Modal / Quest Details view with tech stack tags, system architecture highlights, live demo link, and github repo link

key_features_and_sections.name: Final Stage: High Score & Insert Coin Contact
features: Arcade High Score Leaderboard showing top recruiter/interviewer messages or candidate pitch
Insert Coin Contact Form with real-time field validation, glowing interactive arcade buttons, and instant feedback toast notification using Sonner
Direct email / LinkedIn / GitHub arcade link triggers

key_features_and_sections.name: Konami Code Easter Egg
features: Global keyboard listener for ↑ ↑ ↓ ↓ ← → ← → B A sequence
Triggers 'GOD MODE UNLOCKED' particle explosion, retro rainbow palette, and secret recruiter cheat code modal!

image_urls.description: Vintage arcade machine glowing with cyan and purple neon lights
Retro arcade cabinet screen for high energy project showcase background
Deep blue neon arcade machine background

rules: Hover states on all arcade buttons must have snappy scale (scale-105 or translate-y-[-2px]) with box-shadow glow increase
Scroll reveals must use staggered opacity + y-axis slide-in with pixel snapping feel
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: disable intense flickers if reduced motion is requested by browser
Strictly avoid transition: all; always specify distinct animated CSS properties

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, and modal triggers MUST have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='press-start-button', data-testid='contact-submit-btn', data-testid='quest-card-1')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_wcag: Maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for terminal text over dark backgrounds
testing_and_accessibility.focus_states: Visible high-contrast neon outline on keyboard focus (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-400 focus:outline-none)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the index.css imports Google Fonts for Press Start 2P, VT323, Pixelify Sans, and JetBrains Mono.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for luxury momentum control.
Build clean JS/TS components under src/components with modular data configuration (e.g. candidate details, project list, skills list in a single editable config file).
Add a fixed CRT scanline overlay and an interactive sound toggle for retro Web Audio SFX.
Make sure Haveloc and HCL GUVI candidacy references are prominently featured in the portfolio header, hero, and bio to guarantee recruiter impact.
